messages:
Alex: Quick postmortem follow-up — we had a vendor-auth + model-registry cascade last night. Root cause: cloud provider auth token storms -> model-registry 401s -> client fallback misconfigured. Need concrete owners, deadlines, and verification steps.
Maria: Agreed. Can we capture all actions in the remediation board and assign owners now? link: /boards/vendor-resilience (I'll take ownership of tracking).
SRE Bot: Incident #48932 summary: auth provider rate spikes -> 401s to model-registry -> increased client retries -> degraded end-to-end p95. Auto-alerts triggered at 23:12 UTC.
Sam: I'll own the model-registry client hardening: add circuit breaker, retry jitter, and a smoke test for fallback paths. Target: 2026-04-02 EOD. Will open PR by tomorrow. :+1:
Lee: I'll own deploy-time validation for fallback configs (CI gate). ETA: 1 sprint (2026-04-09). Need a sample validation script from Sam to gate on.
Jordan: I'll work with infra to harden cloud auth refresh: tighter backoff, token caching, and TTL/rotation audit. ETA: 2026-04-05. Also proposing a temporary rate-limited secondary auth provider as fallback — will prototype.
Alex: Can we add a canary run in eu-west-1 and us-west-2 to validate fallback and the new client behavior? Assign to Jordan + Sam to coordinate.
Sam: Yes — I'll add a canary harness + a smoke test. Quick test command I'll use for the harness:
```
./smoke_test --model-registry https://staging-registry.redwood --auth-token stale --enable-fallback
```
Sam: I'll also add a unit test that simulates 401 storms and asserts fallback latency < 200ms for the first failover attempt.
Maria: Please add each action to the remediation board with: owner, ETA, verification steps, and post-change monitoring query. I'll run weekly rollup and ping owners. :calendar:
Lee: I'll pair with Sam on the validation script and write a short rollback runbook for the canary. Will add the runbook link to the board.
Alex: Acceptance criteria for closure:
- fallback verified in canary under simulated auth failure
- deploy gate prevents bad fallback config from reaching prod
- auth rotation automated and audited
- post-change error rate p95 < 5% over 24h
Make sure the board has explicit verification steps matching these.
SRE Bot: Reminder posted: weekly follow-up meeting Thu 10:00 PT (recurring). Meeting link: https://meet.redwood/incident-followup
Jordan: I'll post the terraform diff for the rate-limited secondary auth provider by EOD Mon and link to a short test plan.
Maria: Thanks — I'll update the incident postmortem with owners + dates and mark this thread as the official follow-up channel. We'll reconvene at the Thu checkin and close items as they verify. :rocket:
